context: Mei reorganizes the laundry; Daichi helps casually.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 大ちゃん、洗濯物、移してくれる?
lines.en: Daichi, could you move the laundry for me?
lines.style: Warm and present, gentle request. Soft attack. The ease of asking someone you trust. Slight lift at the end — not urgent, just a familiar ask.

lines.speaker: daichi_kansai
lines.en: Yeah, I'll take care of it.
lines.style: Kansai-warm, immediate agreement. Light and assured. A small nod lives in the voice — no hesitation, just moving to help. Slight Kansai drawl on the closing.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: やめる前に、夢中、なってる!
lines.en: But you get so focused you forget to come back!
lines.style: Playful teasing, affectionate exasperation. Brighter energy than before. Laughing a little at him — not unkind, just the small joke of knowing someone too well.

lines.speaker: daichi_kansai
lines.jp: ベルト、ようけ、片付けたで!
lines.en: I cleaned up a lot of stuff — look, I did it!
lines.style: Kansai warmth with genuine pride underneath. Upbeat, almost childlike in wanting acknowledgment. The eagerness of someone showing off a little for someone he loves.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 焼いたケーキ、後で食べようね。
lines.en: Let's have the cake I baked later, okay?
lines.style: Soft and inviting, a gentle proposal. Warm contentment in the pacing. The voice of someone settling into an afternoon together, offering something small and meaningful.

lines.speaker: daichi_kansai
lines.jp: レジ、買い物、後で済ますわ。
lines.en: I'll finish the shopping at the register later.
lines.style: Kansai ease, matter-of-fact reassurance. Composed but present. The practical voice of someone working out the day's rhythm — no stress, just planning ahead together.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.style: Tender and genuine, soft gratitude. Slight catch on the compliment — not performative, truly meant. The quiet voice of someone allowing herself to lean on someone solid.
